sports.title: Suthar scripts history on debut, registers best bowling figures in 38 years
sports.body: Manav Suthar enjoyed a dream Test debut against Afghanistan, claiming 6/33. The 23-year-old registered the best bowling figures in an innings on Test debut by an Indian in 38 years. It is the best since Narendra Hirwani's 8/61 against West Indies in 1988. The left-arm spinner helped bowl Afghanistan out for 152 and joined an elite list featuring Hirwani, R Ashwin, Dilip Doshi and Syed Abid Ali.

bullets: Manav Suthar enjoyed a dream Test debut against Afghanistan, claiming 6/33.
The 23-year-old registered the best bowling figures in an innings on Test debut by an Indian in 38 years.
The left-arm spinner helped bowl Afghanistan out for 152 and joined an elite list featuring Hirwani, R Ashwin, Dilip Doshi and Syed Abid Ali.
summary.tldr: Manav Suthar enjoyed a dream Test debut against Afghanistan, claiming 6/33.
